title: Trump arrives just as Southeast Asian summit is ending, but still looms over talks
summary_full: President Donald Trump's brief visit gave the appearance to some that the trip was little more than a stopover on his way to meet Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.
